goal_a_reason: Free-text paraphrasing requires semantic similarity judgment; an LLM judge tolerates valid rephrasings like 'Hi Alice!' vs 'Hello, Alice!' without needing tool-call inspection.
goal_b_reason: Structured JSON comparison with tolerance for key ordering and minor whitespace is exactly what the deterministic tree-based json-similarity evaluator provides — no LLM needed.
goal_c_reason: Pass/fail on the presence of a literal substring ('deployment succeeded') anywhere in the output is the exact use case for the contains evaluator.
